title: WhatsApp Business Messaging Webhook
description: Raw landing field group for WhatsApp Business Messaging webhook payloads. Preserves the original webhook structure including entry, changes, contacts, and messages arrays without upstream transformation.

xdm:whatsappWebhook.title: WhatsApp Webhook Payload
xdm:whatsappWebhook.description: The top-level WhatsApp Business API webhook payload.

xdm:entry.title: Entry
xdm:entry.description: Array of WhatsApp Business Account entries. Typically one entry per webhook delivery.

items.title: WABA Entry
items.description: A WhatsApp Business Account entry. One entry per WABA that received a message.

xdm:changes.title: Changes
xdm:changes.description: Array of change events for this WABA.

items.title: Change
items.description: A single change event — either incoming messages or delivery statuses.

xdm:field.title: Field
xdm:field.description: The type of change. 'messages' for inbound messages; 'statuses' for delivery receipts.

xdm:value.title: Change Value
xdm:value.description: The payload of a change event, containing metadata, sender contacts, messages, and statuses.

xdm:metadata.title: Metadata
xdm:metadata.description: Information about the business phone number that received the message.

xdm:display_phone_number.title: Display Phone Number
xdm:display_phone_number.description: The business phone number displayed to customers.

xdm:phone_number_id.title: Phone Number ID
xdm:phone_number_id.description: The WhatsApp business phone number ID.

xdm:contacts.title: Sender Contacts
xdm:contacts.description: Profile information for the senders in this batch. Join to messages on contacts.wa_id === messages.from.

xdm:wa_id.title: WhatsApp ID
xdm:wa_id.description: The sender's WhatsApp ID (typically their phone number without +).

xdm:messages.title: Messages
xdm:messages.description: Inbound messages received in this webhook delivery.

items.title: WhatsApp Message
items.description: An inbound WhatsApp message. The type field determines which type-specific object is present.

xdm:id.title: Message ID
xdm:id.description: Unique WhatsApp message ID (wamid). Stable and unique across all messages.

xdm:from.title: From
xdm:from.description: The sender's phone number in E.164 format (without +). Matches senderContact.wa_id.

xdm:timestamp.title: Timestamp
xdm:timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) when the message was sent.

xdm:type.title: Message Type
xdm:type.description: The type of message received. Determines which type-specific object is populated.

xdm:context.title: Context
xdm:context.description: Present when the message is a reply to a previous message.

xdm:id.title: Replied-To Message ID
xdm:id.description: The wamid of the message being replied to.

xdm:from.title: Replied-To From
xdm:from.description: Phone number of the sender of the original message.

xdm:id.title: Media ID
xdm:id.description: WhatsApp media ID. Use the Media API to retrieve the file.

xdm:mime_type.title: MIME Type
xdm:mime_type.description: MIME type of the audio file, e.g. 'audio/ogg; codecs=opus'.

xdm:sha256.title: SHA-256
xdm:sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the audio file for integrity verification.

xdm:url.title: Media URL
xdm:url.description: URL to download the audio file directly from Meta's CDN.

xdm:voice.title: Voice
xdm:voice.description: True if the audio was recorded using the WhatsApp in-app voice recorder.

xdm:id.title: Media ID
xdm:id.description: WhatsApp media ID. Use the Media API to retrieve the file.

xdm:mime_type.title: MIME Type
xdm:mime_type.description: MIME type of the image, e.g. 'image/jpeg'.

xdm:sha256.title: SHA-256
xdm:sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the image file for integrity verification.

xdm:caption.title: Caption
xdm:caption.description: Optional caption sent with the image.

xdm:url.title: Media URL
xdm:url.description: URL to download the image file directly from Meta's CDN.

xdm:id.title: Media ID
xdm:id.description: WhatsApp media ID. Use the Media API to retrieve the file.

xdm:mime_type.title: MIME Type
xdm:mime_type.description: MIME type of the video, e.g. 'video/mp4'.

xdm:sha256.title: SHA-256
xdm:sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the video file for integrity verification.

xdm:caption.title: Caption
xdm:caption.description: Optional caption sent with the video.

xdm:url.title: Media URL
xdm:url.description: URL to download the video file directly from Meta's CDN.

xdm:id.title: Media ID
xdm:id.description: WhatsApp media ID. Use the Media API to retrieve the file.

xdm:mime_type.title: MIME Type
xdm:mime_type.description: MIME type of the document, e.g. 'application/pdf'.

xdm:sha256.title: SHA-256
xdm:sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the document file for integrity verification.

xdm:filename.title: Filename
xdm:filename.description: Original filename of the document as sent by the user.

xdm:caption.title: Caption
xdm:caption.description: Optional caption sent with the document.

xdm:url.title: Media URL
xdm:url.description: URL to download the document file directly from Meta's CDN.

xdm:id.title: Media ID
xdm:id.description: WhatsApp media ID. Use the Media API to retrieve the file.

xdm:mime_type.title: MIME Type
xdm:mime_type.description: MIME type of the sticker. Always 'image/webp'.

xdm:sha256.title: SHA-256
xdm:sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the sticker file for integrity verification.

xdm:animated.title: Animated
xdm:animated.description: True if the sticker is animated.

xdm:url.title: Media URL
xdm:url.description: URL to download the sticker file directly from Meta's CDN.

xdm:latitude.title: Latitude
xdm:latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

xdm:longitude.title: Longitude
xdm:longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

xdm:name.title: Name
xdm:name.description: Name of the location, if provided by the sender.

xdm:address.title: Address
xdm:address.description: Street address of the location, if provided by the sender.

xdm:contact_cards.title: Contact Cards
xdm:contact_cards.description: Present when type = 'contacts'. An array of vCard-like contact objects shared by the sender.

xdm:interactive.title: Interactive Reply
xdm:interactive.description: Present when type = 'interactive'. Sent when a user taps a button or selects a list item.

xdm:type.title: Interactive Type
xdm:type.description: 'button_reply' when a quick-reply button is tapped; 'list_reply' when a list item is selected.

xdm:button.title: Button
xdm:button.description: Present when type = 'button'. Sent when a user taps a button in a template message.

xdm:order.title: Order
xdm:order.description: Present when type = 'order'. Sent when a user places an order from a catalog.

xdm:catalog_id.title: Catalog ID
xdm:catalog_id.description: ID of the WhatsApp catalog the order was placed from.

xdm:text.title: Order Note
xdm:text.description: Optional note from the customer accompanying the order.

xdm:product_retailer_id.title: Product Retailer ID
xdm:product_retailer_id.description: The retailer's SKU/product ID from the catalog.

xdm:item_price.title: Item Price
xdm:item_price.description: Unit price of the product at time of order.

xdm:reaction.title: Reaction
xdm:reaction.description: Present when type = 'reaction'. Sent when a user reacts to a message with an emoji.

xdm:message_id.title: Reacted-To Message ID
xdm:message_id.description: The wamid of the message that was reacted to.

xdm:emoji.title: Emoji
xdm:emoji.description: The emoji used as the reaction. Empty string means the reaction was removed.

xdm:statuses.title: Statuses
xdm:statuses.description: Delivery and read receipt status updates.

items.title: Message Status
items.description: Delivery and read receipt for an outbound message.

xdm:id.title: Message ID
xdm:id.description: The wamid of the outbound message this status refers to.

xdm:status.title: Status
xdm:status.description: Current delivery state of the message.

xdm:timestamp.title: Timestamp
xdm:timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp when this status was recorded.

xdm:recipient_id.title: Recipient ID
xdm:recipient_id.description: Phone number of the message recipient.
